problem: Write a function that returns the square of a number.
Write a function that checks if a number is even.
Write a function that returns the maximum of two numbers.
solution: int max(int a, int b) { return a>b?a:b; }

problem: Write a function that returns the factorial of n.
Write a function that reverses a string.
solution: string reverse(string s) { reverse(s.begin(),s.end()); return s; }
